explainer_content.short_definition: The 1980s underground guitar road that alternative rock later made famous.
explainer_content.history_capsule: College rock connected jangle, punk remnants, literary lyrics, and independent labels through radio stations and regional scenes.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It built the audience and values that made 1990s alternative possible.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: It is less about one sound than a family of guitar-band approaches tied by non-mainstream circulation.
